title: Sign BLR acceptance characterization
statement: For any $n\ge 0$, function $f:\{−1,1\}^n\to\{−1,1\}$, and $x,y\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$, the sign BLR tester accepts $f$ on seed $(x,y)$ if and only if its binary encoding $g:\mathbb{F}_2^n\to\mathbb{F}_2$ satisfies $g(x)+g(y)=g(x+y)$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ maps the $n$-dimensional sign cube to the signs
